name: grout
title: Grout
description: For tilers and bathroom fitters: every title is a lettered tile frieze, one fired black capital per gloss-white tile between two courses of turquoise border tiles, on a matt plaster ground, with each price on a glazed cartouche tile.

tokens.--font-tile: the fixed-pitch face of everything fired on a tile: titles, phone numbers, prices; also section headings, the name under a quote, and code
tokens.--font-body: body text, the menu and small labels
tokens.--text-s: small text: the menu, labels, table headings, the contact button, hours and area, the name under a quote, footer, and wide tables on phones
tokens.--text-m: base body size, and section headings
tokens.--text-l: the standfirst, customer quotes, third-level headings, the heading over the phone number, and prices on cartouche tiles
tokens.--tracking: letter spacing of capital labels, the menu and section headings
tokens.--color-bg: page background: the matt plaster wall (also the joints of the tiles beside a quote)
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings, link text and the keyboard focus ring
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: labels, menu links, table headings, hours and area, footer
tokens.--color-accent: the glaze: border courses of every frieze, cartouche tiles and price-tile frames, the tile on the contact button, link underlines, the current menu item, list bullets, checklist and service-index tiles, the tiles beside a quote, rules, and one tile of the mark beside the site name
tokens.--color-tile: face of the gloss-white tiles: letter tiles, cartouche and price panels, the contact button, code, and the mark beside the site name
tokens.--color-shine: the highlight on each white letter tile, the cartouche panel and the contact button
tokens.--color-shade: the soft shadow along the lower edge and in the lower corner of each letter tile
tokens.--color-fired: letters and figures fired on white tiles, the contact button label, and code text
tokens.--color-grout: joints between tiles and round each price tile, the edge of friezes, cartouches, the contact button and code blocks, and quiet lines: under section headings, table rows and service names, round images, above the footer
tokens.--color-glint: the highlight on glazed tiles: border courses, cartouches, checklist and service-index tiles, the contact button, the tiles beside a quote, rules
tokens.--tiles-s: tiles in one row of a page title on phones; service titles get two more, and that is the longest row of the phone number at every width
tokens.--tiles-m: tiles in one row of a page title on tablets; service titles get half as many again
tokens.--tiles-l: tiles in one row of a page title on wide screens, and of a service title in the two-column list
tokens.--tile-letter: size of a letter as a share of its tile (1 fills the tile's height)
tokens.--course: height of a border course as a share of a letter tile
tokens.--grout: width of the joint between tiles (one and a half times this above and below a price tile, whose glazed frame is twice it); also the thickness of link underlines and of the lines under section headings and above the footer
tokens.--scoop: radius of the scooped corners on cartouche and price tiles
tokens.--measure: widest a column of text may get
tokens.--side-width: width of the right-hand column (price, checklist, phone, service index) on wide screens
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: under section headings, between list items
tokens.--space-2: small gap: inside cartouches and table rows, between label and value
tokens.--space-3: standard gap: between paragraphs, under a frieze, between a card's title and text; the tiles beside a quote and the height of a rule
tokens.--space-4: gap between sections and between cards; side padding inside a cartouche; list indent
tokens.--space-5: gap between the two columns, above the footer, and the length of one slip in a rule
tokens.--focus-width: thickness of the keyboard focus ring
tokens.--tap: smallest height of anything meant to be tapped: menu links, the site name, page links, the contact button (and the width of its glazed tile)
